```{r}
RNA_reads <- read.csv("/media/erlantz/71DE167A75E99BB4/Pool_35/RNA/Statistics/Stats_intestine_plate1_plate2.csv", sep = "\t")
gDNA_reads <- read.csv("/media/erlantz/71DE167A75E99BB4/Pool_35/gDNA/Statistics/Stats_intestine_plate1_plate2_methylation.csv", sep = "\t")


gDNA_reads2 <- gDNA_reads[match(RNA_reads$Sample, gDNA_reads$Sample_RNA),]
rownames(RNA_reads) <- RNA_reads$Sample
rownames(gDNA_reads2) <- gDNA_reads2$Sample_RNA
gDNA_RNA_stats <-merge(gDNA_reads2,RNA_reads, by = "row.names",suffixes = c("_gDNA", "_RNA"))
RNA_reads$Dox <- factor(RNA_reads$Dox, levels=c("Minus","48hDox","48hDox-72hChase"))

#RNA
p <- ggplot(RNA_reads, aes(x =log2(PE_aligned), y =  log2(UMI), color=Dox)) +
  geom_point()+
geom_abline(slope = 1,             # 45-degree line (y = x)
    intercept = 0,         # Start at origin (0,0)
    color = "black",         # Line color
    linetype = "dashed",   # Line style (solid/dashed/dotted)
    linewidth = 0.5        # Line thickness
  )+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#A50F15","#377EB8","#4DAF4A"))+
   theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "plain", color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(size =11, face = "plain", hjust = 0.5, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, color = "black", face = "plain", hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y.left  = element_text(size = 11, color = "black", face = "plain", hjust = 1),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "plain"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", size = 0.5),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "plain", size = 11),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"),   # overall size
    legend.key.width = unit(0.2, "cm"),  # width
    legend.key.height = unit(0.2, "cm"))+
    guides(fill= guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "",
    y = "Log2(RNA UMIs)",
    x = "Log2(Mapped reads)")
  #ylim(0,7)+
  #xlim(0,7)

  # Save the plot
  g <- ggplotGrob(p)

# Extract all legend boxes
  legends <- g$grobs[which(sapply(g$grobs, function(x) x$name) == "guide-box")]

# Save each legend manually (they're stacked in one box)
  legend_combined <- legends[[1]]  # Usually contains both

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,"RNA_unique_against_aligned_intestine_legend.png"),legend_combined,  dpi=300, width =3.15, height = 0.2)
  p_nolegend <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")

gDNA_reads3 = gDNA_reads[gDNA_reads$DCM_UMI_wholegene >300, ]
RNA_reads3 = RNA_reads[RNA_reads$UMI >300,  ]
gDNA_reads3$distance_to_diag <- abs(gDNA_reads3$DCM_unique - gDNA_reads3$Aligned) / sqrt(2)
gDNA_reads3$distance_to_diag_CpG <- abs(gDNA_reads3$CpG_unique - gDNA_reads3$Aligned) / sqrt(2)
RNA_reads3$distance_to_diag_RNA <- abs(RNA_reads3$UMI - RNA_reads3$PE_aligned) / sqrt(2)

# Compare red vs blue
dox_dist <- gDNA_reads3$distance_to_diag[gDNA_reads3$Dox == "48hDox"]
minus_dist  <- gDNA_reads3$distance_to_diag[gDNA_reads3$Dox == "Minus"]
chase_dist  <- gDNA_reads3$distance_to_diag[gDNA_reads3$Dox == "48hDox-72hChase"]

dox_dist <- gDNA_reads3$distance_to_diag_CpG[gDNA_reads3$Dox == "48hDox"]
minus_dist  <- gDNA_reads3$distance_to_diag_CpG[gDNA_reads3$Dox == "Minus"]
chase_dist  <- gDNA_reads3$distance_to_diag_CpG[gDNA_reads3$Dox == "48hDox-72hChase"]

dox_dist <- RNA_reads3$distance_to_diag_RNA[RNA_reads3$Dox == "48hDox"]
minus_dist  <- RNA_reads3$distance_to_diag_RNA[RNA_reads3$Dox == "Minus"]
chase_dist  <- RNA_reads3$distance_to_diag_RNA[RNA_reads3$Dox == "48hDox-72hChase"]
# Use a Wilcoxon rank-sum test (non-parametric)
wilcox.test(dox_dist, minus_dist)

# Optional: Visualize
```

```{r}
Minus_all <- read.table("/media/erlantz/71DE167A75E99BB4/Pool_35/Harber/Large_harber_plate_integration/metagene/All_genes/merged_DCM_Minus_rcSite_GraphOutput.txt")
Plus_all <- read.table("/media/erlantz/71DE167A75E99BB4/Pool_35/Harber/Large_harber_plate_integration/metagene/All_genes/merged_DCM_48hDox_rcSite_GraphOutput.txt")
Chase_all <- read.table("/media/erlantz/71DE167A75E99BB4/Pool_35/Harber/Large_harber_plate_integration/metagene/All_genes/merged_DCM_48hDox-72hChase_rcSite_GraphOutput.txt")


Chase_all$Norm_DCM <- Chase_all$V2 / (405327)*1000000
Plus_all$Norm_DCM <- Plus_all$V2 / (759636)*1000000
Minus_all$Norm_DCM <- Minus_all$V2 / (109778)*1000000

library(reshape2)
All_DCM <- data.frame(Position=Chase_all$V1,
                               Plus=Plus_all$Norm_DCM,
                           Chase=Chase_all$Norm_DCM,
                           Minus=Minus_all$Norm_DCM)
All_DCM_melt <- melt(All_DCM, id.vars = "Position")
All_DCM_melt$variable <- factor(All_DCM_melt$variable, levels = c("Plus","Chase","Minus"))

p <- ggplot(All_DCM_melt, aes(x = Position, y = value, color=variable)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.75) +
  ylab("(DCM Reads / Sites)/DCM depth")+
```

```{r}
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(gprofiler2)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(GOSemSim)
library(enrichplot)
cluster<-list()
egos<-list()
clusters<-levels(factor(Intestine_RNA_plates_seurat2_EE@meta.data$unintegrated_clusters_1.1))
Intestine_RNA_plates_seurat2_EE_markers_sig <- Intestine_RNA_plates_seurat2_EE_markers[Intestine_RNA_plates_seurat2_EE_markers$p_val<0.05,]

#enrich pathways
unique_clusters <- unique(Intestine_RNA_plates_seurat2_EE_markers_sig$cluster)
unique_clusters <- as.factor(c("1","2","3","4"))
# Initialize a list to store results for each cluster
ego<- list()
ont <- "BP"  # Define ontology

for (p in unique_clusters) {
  # Subset data
  cluster_data <- Intestine_RNA_plates_seurat2_EE_markers_sig[Intestine_RNA_plates_seurat2_EE_markers_sig$cluster == p, ]
  
  # Gene conversion
  test3 <- gconvert(cluster_data$gene, organism = "mmusculus", target = "ENSG", filter_na = TRUE)
  valid_genes <- unique(na.omit(test3$target))
  
  if (length(valid_genes) == 0) {
    message("No valid gene conversions for cluster ", p)
    next
  }
  
  # GO enrichment
  result <- tryCatch({
    enrichGO(
      gene = valid_genes,
      OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
      keyType = 'ENSEMBL',
      ont = ont,
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
      qvalueCutoff = 0.05,
      readable = TRUE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("enrichGO failed for cluster ", p, ": ", e$message)
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  if (is.null(result) || nrow(result@result) == 0) {
    message("No GO enrichment results for cluster ", p)
    next
  }
  
  # Store and visualize
  ego[[as.character(p)]] <- result
  
  if (any(result@result$qvalue <= 0.05)) {
    png(file = paste0("/media/erlantz/71DE167A75E99BB4/Pool_35/andrea_paper/GO_EEC/", p, "_", ont, ".png"), 
        width = 6.8, height = 6, units = "in", res = 150)
    print(dotplot(result))
    dev.off()
  } else {
    message("No significant terms for cluster ", p)
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Check batch effect correction (batches should mix well in PCA)

integrated_seurat <- FindNeighbors(integrated_seurat, dims = 1:15, reduction = "pca")
```

```{r}
cell_info$extra <- NULL
```

```{r}
output_dir <- "/media/erlantz/71DE167A75E99BB4/Pool_35/Harber/Large_harber_plate_integration/AUC_moduleScore"

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggplot2)
library(FSA)   # for dunnTest()

# Define features

features2 <-  grep("_kNN$", colnames(integrated_seurat@meta.data), value = TRUE)

plots <- list()

# Desired cluster order
cluster_order <- c("ISC", "Enterocyte", "Goblet", "Paneth", "Tuft", "Enteroendocrine")

for (feat in features2) {
  
  # Extract expression + metadata
  df <- FetchData(subset(integrated_seurat, Dataset2 %in% "pRNA"), vars = c(feat, "cell_identity_int2"))
  colnames(df) <- c("expression", "cluster")
  
  # Ensure correct types
  df$expression <- as.numeric(df$expression)
  df$cluster <- factor(df$cluster, levels = cluster_order)
  
  # --- Kruskal-Wallis global test ---
  kw <- kruskal.test(expression ~ cluster, data = df)
  
  # --- Dunn’s test with BH correction ---
  dunn_res <- dunnTest(expression ~ cluster, data = df, method = "bh")
  dunn_table <- dunn_res$res
  
  # Keep only significant comparisons
  dunn_table <- dunn_table %>%
    filter(P.adj < 0.05)
  
  if (nrow(dunn_table) > 0) {
    # Add significance stars
    dunn_table <- dunn_table %>%
      mutate(stars = case_when(
        P.adj < 1e-5  ~ "****",
        P.adj < 1e-4  ~ "***",
        P.adj < 1e-2  ~ "**",
        P.adj < 0.05  ~ "*"
      ))
    
    # Add group1 / group2 columns
    dunn_table <- dunn_table %>%
      mutate(group1 = sapply(strsplit(Comparison, " - "), `[`, 1),
             group2 = sapply(strsplit(Comparison, " - "), `[`, 2),
             y.position = max(df$expression, na.rm = TRUE) * 
                          seq(1.05, 1.05 + 0.05*(nrow(.)-1), 0.05))
  }
  
  # --- Plot ---
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = cluster, y = expression)) +
    geom_violin(aes(fill = cluster), trim = FALSE) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5, fill="white",colour="black") +
    #scale_fill_manual(values=publication_colors_27)+
    labs(
      title = paste0(feat, "\nKruskal–Wallis p=", signif(kw$p.value, 3)),
      y = feat,
      x = "Cluster"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  
  # Add only significant annotations
  if (nrow(dunn_table) > 0) {
    p <- p + stat_pvalue_manual(
      dunn_table,
      label = "stars",
      xmin = "group1",
      xmax = "group2",
      y.position = "y.position",
      tip.length = 0.01
    )
  }
  
  plots[[feat]] <- p
}
# Save plots

dir.create(output_dir2, showWarnings = FALSE)

  ggsave(

    plot = plots[[feat]],
    width = 5,
    height = 4,
    dpi = 300
  )

compute_celltype_significance <- function(scores_df,
                                          suffix = "1",
                                          method = c("empirical", "zscore")) {
  method <- match.arg(method)
  
  if (!"celltype" %in% colnames(scores_df)) {
    stop("scores_df must contain a column named 'celltype'")
  }
  
  # Extract only score columns
  score_cols <- grep(paste0(suffix, "$"), colnames(scores_df), value = TRUE)
  scores <- as.matrix(scores_df[ , score_cols, drop = FALSE])
  celltypes <- scores_df$celltype
  
  n <- nrow(scores)
  pvals <- numeric(n)
  assigned_scores <- numeric(n)
  
  for (i in 1:n) {
    ct <- celltypes[i]
    ct_col <- paste0(ct, suffix)
    if (!ct_col %in% colnames(scores)) {
      stop(paste("Celltype", ct, "not found among score columns"))
    }
    
    assigned_scores[i] <- scores[i, ct_col]
    others <- scores[i, setdiff(colnames(scores), ct_col)]
    
    if (method == "empirical") {
      pvals[i] <- mean(others >= assigned_scores[i])
    } else if (method == "zscore") {
      mu <- mean(others)
      sdv <- sd(others)
      if (sdv == 0) {
        pvals[i] <- 1
      } else {
        z <- (assigned_scores[i] - mu) / sdv
        pvals[i] <- 1 - pnorm(z)
      }
    }
  }
  
  fdr <- p.adjust(pvals, method = "BH")
  
  out <- data.frame(
    celltype = celltypes,
    assigned_score = assigned_scores,
    pval = pvals,
    FDR = fdr,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  rownames(out) <- rownames(scores_df)
  return(out)
}
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
# (load other libraries as needed)

# 1. Compute per-cell sums and normalized proportions for marker gene sets
compute_marker_proportions <- function(seurat_obj,
                                       marker_list,
                                       assay = "RNA",
                                       slot = "counts",
                                       normalize = TRUE) {
  # marker_list: named list, names = cluster labels (e.g. "ClusterA"),
  # values = character vector of marker gene names (symbols must match rownames(seurat_obj))
  #
  # returns: data.frame rows=cells, cols = "<Cluster>_marker_prop" (proportion per cell)
  
  if (!assay %in% names(seurat_obj@assays)) {
    stop("Assay not found in Seurat object")
  }
  mat <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, slot = slot, assay = assay, as.sparse = TRUE)
  # mat is genes x cells (rows genes, cols cells)
  
  # total counts per cell (for proportion denominator)
  total_counts_per_cell <- Matrix::colSums(mat)
  total_counts_per_cell[total_counts_per_cell == 0] <- NA  # avoid division by zero later
  
  out <- matrix(0, nrow = ncol(mat), ncol = length(marker_list))
  colnames(out) <- paste0(names(marker_list), "_marker_prop")
  rownames(out) <- colnames(mat)
  
  for (i in seq_along(marker_list)) {
    cluster_name <- names(marker_list)[i]
    genes <- unique(marker_list[[i]])
    genes_present <- intersect(genes, rownames(mat))
    n_genes_present <- length(genes_present)
    if (n_genes_present == 0) {
      warning(sprintf("No marker genes of cluster '%s' found in assay rows; filling 0s", cluster_name))
      next
    }
    # sum counts for those genes per cell
    sum_set_counts <- Matrix::colSums(mat[genes_present, , drop = FALSE])
    # normalize by number of genes present (so gene-set size differences are accounted)
    if (normalize) {
      norm_sum <- sum_set_counts / n_genes_present
    } else {
      norm_sum <- sum_set_counts
    }
    # proportion of total counts going to this (size-normalized) gene set
    prop <- norm_sum / total_counts_per_cell
    # replace NA (cells with zero total) with 0
    prop[is.na(prop)] <- 0
    out[, i] <- prop
  }
  
  return(as.data.frame(out))
}


# 2. Significance test using the assigned celltype (assumes column 'celltype' provided)
#    Uses either 'empirical' (fraction of other gene-set props >= assigned prop),
#    'zscore' (z vs others), or 'rank' (rank-based)
compute_celltype_prop_significance <- function(prop_df,           # dataframe from compute_marker_proportions
                                               celltype_vec,      # character vector per cell with assigned celltype (exact cluster names)
                                               suffix = "_marker_prop",
                                               method = c("empirical", "zscore", "rank"),
                                               adjust_within = c("global", "by_celltype")) {
  method <- match.arg(method)
  adjust_within <- match.arg(adjust_within)
  if (length(celltype_vec) != nrow(prop_df)) stop("celltype_vec length must match rows of prop_df")
  
  # Only keep columns ending with suffix
  score_cols <- grep(paste0(suffix, "$"), colnames(prop_df), value = TRUE)
  scores <- as.matrix(prop_df[, score_cols, drop = FALSE])  # cells x gene-sets
  celltypes <- celltype_vec
  n <- nrow(scores)
  pvals <- numeric(n)
  assigned_scores <- numeric(n)
  
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    ct <- celltypes[i]
    ct_col <- paste0(ct, suffix)
    if (!ct_col %in% colnames(scores)) {
      warning(sprintf("cell %s: assigned celltype '%s' not present among score columns. pval set to NA", rownames(prop_df)[i], ct))
      pvals[i] <- NA
      assigned_scores[i] <- NA
      next
    }
    assigned_scores[i] <- scores[i, ct_col]
    others <- scores[i, setdiff(colnames(scores), ct_col)]
    
    if (method == "empirical") {
      # fraction of other gene-set props >= assigned -> small if assigned is bigger than almost all others
      pvals[i] <- mean(others >= assigned_scores[i])
    } else if (method == "zscore") {
      mu <- mean(others)
      sdv <- sd(others)
      if (is.na(sdv) || sdv == 0) {
        pvals[i] <- 1
      } else {
        z <- (assigned_scores[i] - mu) / sdv
        pvals[i] <- 1 - pnorm(z)   # one-sided: prob that a normal var > observed z
      }
    } else if (method == "rank") {
      # rank among all values in this cell (higher = better)
      # smaller p = higher rank (rank/numSets)
      rnk <- rank(-c(scores[i, ]))[which(colnames(scores) == ct_col)]
      pvals[i] <- rnk / ncol(scores)
    }
  }
  
  # Adjust p-values for multiple testing:
  if (adjust_within == "global") {
    FDR <- p.adjust(pvals, method = "BH")
  } else {
    # adjust p-values within each celltype separately
    FDR <- numeric(length(pvals))
    FDR[] <- NA
    for (ct in unique(celltypes)) {
      idx <- which(celltypes == ct & !is.na(pvals))
      if (length(idx) > 0) {
        FDR[idx] <- p.adjust(pvals[idx], method = "BH")
      }
    }
  }
  
  out <- data.frame(
    assigned_celltype = celltypes,
    assigned_prop = assigned_scores,
    pval = pvals,
    FDR = FDR,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  rownames(out) <- rownames(prop_df)
  return(out)
}


# 3. Convenience wrapper: compute props from Seurat object, test, and merge into seurat@meta.data
compute_and_store_marker_significance <- function(seurat_obj,
                                                  marker_list,
                                                  celltype_meta = "cell_identity_int2",   # metadata column with assigned type
                                                  assay = "RNA",
                                                  slot = "counts",
                                                  suffix = "_marker_prop",
                                                  method = "rank",
                                                  adjust_within = "by_celltype",
                                                  normalize_gene_set = TRUE,
                                                  meta_prefix = "marker_") {
  # compute proportions
  props <- compute_marker_proportions(seurat_obj, marker_list, assay = assay, slot = slot,
                                     normalize = normalize_gene_set)
  # ensure rownames match cellnames
  # run test
  celltype_vec <- seurat_obj@meta.data[[celltype_meta]]
  names(celltype_vec) <- rownames(seurat_obj@meta.data)
  res <- compute_celltype_prop_significance(props, celltype_vec, suffix = suffix,
                                            method = method, adjust_within = adjust_within)
  # merge into metadata
  # prefix column names so they don't collide
  md <- seurat_obj@meta.data
  md[[paste0(meta_prefix, "assigned_prop")]] <- res$assigned_prop[rownames(md)]
  md[[paste0(meta_prefix, "pval")]] <- res$pval[rownames(md)]
  md[[paste0(meta_prefix, "FDR")]] <- res$FDR[rownames(md)]
  seurat_obj@meta.data <- md
  return(list(seurat = seurat_obj, props = props, test_res = res))
}

library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)

# 1. Compute per-cell proportions relative to total marker counts
compute_marker_proportions_relative <- function(seurat_obj,
                                                marker_list,
                                                assay = "RNA",
                                                slot = "counts",
                                                normalize = TRUE) {
  mat <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, slot = slot, assay = assay, as.sparse = TRUE)
  
  out_raw <- matrix(0, nrow = ncol(mat), ncol = length(marker_list))
  colnames(out_raw) <- paste0(names(marker_list), "_marker_prop")
  rownames(out_raw) <- colnames(mat)
  
  for (i in seq_along(marker_list)) {
    cluster_name <- names(marker_list)[i]
    genes <- unique(marker_list[[i]])
    genes_present <- intersect(genes, rownames(mat))
    n_genes_present <- length(genes_present)
    if (n_genes_present == 0) {
      warning(sprintf("No marker genes of cluster '%s' found; filling 0s", cluster_name))
      next
    }
    sum_set_counts <- Matrix::colSums(mat[genes_present, , drop = FALSE])
    if (normalize) {
      sum_set_counts <- sum_set_counts / n_genes_present
    }
    out_raw[, i] <- sum_set_counts
  }
  
  # Normalize so proportions sum to 1 across all sets (per cell)
  row_sums <- rowSums(out_raw)
  row_sums[row_sums == 0] <- NA
  out <- sweep(out_raw, 1, row_sums, "/")
  out[is.na(out)] <- 0
  
  return(as.data.frame(out))
}

# 2. Significance test: is assigned celltype’s proportion higher than others?
compute_celltype_prop_significance <- function(prop_df,
                                               celltype_vec,
                                               suffix = "_marker_prop",
                                               method = c("empirical", "zscore", "rank"),
                                               adjust_within = c("global", "by_celltype")) {
  method <- match.arg(method)
  adjust_within <- match.arg(adjust_within)
  
  score_cols <- grep(paste0(suffix, "$"), colnames(prop_df), value = TRUE)
  scores <- as.matrix(prop_df[, score_cols, drop = FALSE])
  celltypes <- celltype_vec
  
  n <- nrow(scores)
  pvals <- numeric(n)
  assigned_scores <- numeric(n)
  
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    ct <- celltypes[i]
    ct_col <- paste0(ct, suffix)
    if (!ct_col %in% colnames(scores)) {
      pvals[i] <- NA
      assigned_scores[i] <- NA
      next
    }
    assigned_scores[i] <- scores[i, ct_col]
    others <- scores[i, setdiff(colnames(scores), ct_col)]
    
    if (method == "empirical") {
      pvals[i] <- mean(others >= assigned_scores[i])
    } else if (method == "zscore") {
      mu <- mean(others)
      sdv <- sd(others)
      if (sdv == 0) {
        pvals[i] <- 1
      } else {
        z <- (assigned_scores[i] - mu) / sdv
        pvals[i] <- 1 - pnorm(z)
      }
    } else if (method == "rank") {
      rnk <- rank(-c(scores[i, ]))[which(colnames(scores) == ct_col)]
      pvals[i] <- rnk / ncol(scores)
    }
  }
  
  if (adjust_within == "global") {
    FDR <- p.adjust(pvals, method = "BH")
  } else {
    FDR <- rep(NA, length(pvals))
    for (ct in unique(celltypes)) {
      idx <- which(celltypes == ct & !is.na(pvals))
      if (length(idx) > 0) {
        FDR[idx] <- p.adjust(pvals[idx], method = "BH")
      }
    }
  }
  
  out <- data.frame(
    assigned_celltype = celltypes,
    assigned_prop = assigned_scores,
    pval = pvals,
    FDR = FDR,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  rownames(out) <- rownames(prop_df)
  return(out)
}

# 3. Wrapper: compute + test + store into Seurat object
compute_and_store_marker_significance <- function(seurat_obj,
                                                  marker_list,
                                                  celltype_meta = "cell_identity_int2",
                                                  assay = "RNA",
                                                  slot = "counts",
                                                  suffix = "_marker_prop",
                                                  method = "rank",
                                                  adjust_within = "by_celltype",
                                                  normalize_gene_set = TRUE,
                                                  meta_prefix = "marker_") {
  props <- compute_marker_proportions_relative(
    seurat_obj, marker_list,
    assay = assay, slot = slot,
    normalize = normalize_gene_set
  )
  
  celltype_vec <- seurat_obj@meta.data[[celltype_meta]]
  names(celltype_vec) <- rownames(seurat_obj@meta.data)
  
  res <- compute_celltype_prop_significance(
    props, celltype_vec,
    suffix = suffix,
    method = method,
    adjust_within = adjust_within
  )
  
  md <- seurat_obj@meta.data
  md[[paste0(meta_prefix, "assigned_prop")]] <- res$assigned_prop[rownames(md)]
  md[[paste0(meta_prefix, "pval")]] <- res$pval[rownames(md)]
  md[[paste0(meta_prefix, "FDR")]] <- res$FDR[rownames(md)]
  seurat_obj@meta.data <- md
  
  return(list(seurat = seurat_obj, props = props, test_res = res))
}

# 4. Heatmap of per-celltype significance proportions
plot_signif_heatmap <- function(test_res, alpha = 0.05, plot_title = NULL) {
  df <- test_res %>%
    mutate(significant = ifelse(!is.na(FDR) & FDR < alpha, 1, 0)) %>%
    group_by(assigned_celltype) %>%
    summarise(total_cells = n(),
              significant_cells = sum(significant),
              prop_significant = significant_cells / total_cells,
              .groups = "drop")
  
  mat <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(assigned_celltype, prop_significant) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("assigned_celltype") %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  # fix case where all values are identical
  if (length(unique(as.vector(mat))) == 1) {
    mat <- mat + rnorm(length(mat), mean = 0, sd = 1e-6)
  }
  
  if (is.null(plot_title)) {
    plot_title <- sprintf("Proportion of significant cells (FDR < %.3f)", alpha)
  }
  
  pheatmap(mat, cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
           main = plot_title, color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "red"))(100))
  
  return(df)
}

group_level_test <- function(props, celltype_vec, suffix = "_marker_prop", threshold = NULL) {
  if (nrow(props) != length(celltype_vec)) stop("props rows must match length of celltype_vec")
  score_cols <- grep(paste0(suffix, "$"), colnames(props), value = TRUE)
  if (length(score_cols) == 0) stop("No score columns found with that suffix")

  # number of gene sets
  k <- length(score_cols)
  if (is.null(threshold)) threshold <- 1 / k

  unique_ct <- sort(unique(celltype_vec))

  results <- tibble::tibble(
    celltype = character(0),
    n_cells = integer(0),
    mean_prop_assigned = numeric(0),
    median_prop_assigned = numeric(0),
    prop_above_threshold = numeric(0),
    wilcox_p = numeric(0),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  for (ct in unique_ct) {
    ct_col <- paste0(ct, suffix)
    if (!ct_col %in% colnames(props)) {
      warning(sprintf("Skipping %s: no column %s in props", ct, ct_col))
      next
    }

    idx_assigned <- which(celltype_vec == ct)
    idx_other <- which(celltype_vec != ct)

    # the proportions for this gene-set in assigned cells vs others
    vals_assigned <- props[idx_assigned, ct_col]
    vals_other    <- props[idx_other, ct_col]

    # descriptive stats
    mean_p <- mean(vals_assigned, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_p  <- median(vals_assigned, na.rm = TRUE)
    prop_above <- mean(vals_assigned > threshold, na.rm = TRUE)

    # wilcoxon one-sided: assigned > other
    # require at least one non-NA in each group and enough data
    wilcox_p <- NA
    if (length(na.omit(vals_assigned)) >= 3 && length(na.omit(vals_other)) >= 3) {
      wt <- wilcox.test(vals_assigned, vals_other, alternative = "greater", exact = FALSE)
      wilcox_p <- wt$p.value
    } else {
      # fallback: if small groups, do a simple Mann-Whitney with exact if possible:
      try({
        wt <- wilcox.test(vals_assigned, vals_other, alternative = "greater")
        wilcox_p <- wt$p.value
      }, silent = TRUE)
    }

    results <- results %>% add_row(
      celltype = ct,
      n_cells = length(idx_assigned),
      mean_prop_assigned = mean_p,
      median_prop_assigned = med_p,
      prop_above_threshold = prop_above,
      wilcox_p = wilcox_p
    )
  }

  # FDR correction across celltypes
  results <- results %>%
    mutate(wilcox_p = as.numeric(wilcox_p)) %>%
    arrange(celltype) %>%
    mutate(wilcox_FDR = p.adjust(wilcox_p, method = "BH"))

  # Plotting helpers
  # 1) barplot: mean proportion per celltype (with proportion above threshold overlay)
  p_bar <- ggplot(results, aes(x = reorder(celltype, -mean_prop_assigned), y = mean_prop_assigned)) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * prop_above_threshold)),
              vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
    labs(x = "Celltype", y = "Mean assigned proportion", title = "Mean assigned proportion per celltype\n(text = % cells > threshold)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  # 2) heatmap: matrix of mean proportions per gene-set (rows) vs celltypes (columns)
  # Build matrix of means: for each gene-set column (CT_marker_prop), compute mean across cells assigned to each CT
  mean_mat <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(score_cols), ncol = length(unique_ct),
                     dimnames = list(score_cols, unique_ct))
  for (ct in unique_ct) {
    idx_assigned <- which(celltype_vec == ct)
    mean_mat[, ct] <- colMeans(props[idx_assigned, score_cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  # small fix if all values identical
  if (length(unique(as.vector(mean_mat))) == 1) mean_mat <- mean_mat + rnorm(length(mean_mat), 0, 1e-8)

  p_heat <- pheatmap::pheatmap(mean_mat,
                               cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE,
                               main = sprintf("Mean gene-set proportion (by assigned celltype)\n(threshold = %.3f)", threshold),
                               silent = TRUE)

  return(list(summary = results, barplot = p_bar, heatmap = p_heat))
}

##Proportions sig per cell

library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(dplyr)

# 1) Compute raw counts per cell per marker set (and optional size-normalized sums)
compute_marker_set_counts <- function(seurat_obj,
                                      marker_list,
                                      assay = "RNA",
                                      slot = "counts",
                                      normalize_by_gene_count = FALSE) {
  # Returns a data.frame (rows=cells) with columns "<Cluster>_set_counts" (raw sums)
  if (!assay %in% names(seurat_obj@assays)) {
    stop("Assay not found in Seurat object")
  }
  mat <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, slot = slot, assay = assay, as.sparse = TRUE)
  out_raw <- matrix(0, nrow = ncol(mat), ncol = length(marker_list))
  colnames(out_raw) <- paste0(names(marker_list), "_set_counts")
  rownames(out_raw) <- colnames(mat)
  
  for (i in seq_along(marker_list)) {
    cluster_name <- names(marker_list)[i]
    genes <- unique(marker_list[[i]])
    genes_present <- intersect(genes, rownames(mat))
    n_genes_present <- length(genes_present)
    if (n_genes_present == 0) {
      warning(sprintf("No marker genes for '%s' found; filling 0s", cluster_name))
      next
    }
    sum_set_counts <- Matrix::colSums(mat[genes_present, , drop = FALSE])
    if (normalize_by_gene_count) {
      sum_set_counts <- sum_set_counts / n_genes_present
    }
    out_raw[, i] <- as.numeric(sum_set_counts)
  }
  as.data.frame(out_raw)
}

# 2) Per-cell binomial test function
#    - prop0 = 1/k by default
#    - min_marker_counts: minimum total marker-set counts (trials) to attempt test; otherwise pval = NA
#    - adjust_within: "global" or "by_celltype"
compute_per_cell_binom_significance <- function(counts_df,          # output of compute_marker_set_counts
                                                celltype_vec,       # vector of assigned celltypes, length = nrow(counts_df)
                                                suffix = "_set_counts",
                                                prop0 = NULL,       # if NULL, set to 1/k automatically
                                                min_marker_counts = 10,
                                                adjust_within = c("global", "by_celltype")) {
  adjust_within <- match.arg(adjust_within)
  score_cols <- grep(paste0(suffix, "$"), colnames(counts_df), value = TRUE)
  if (length(score_cols) == 0) stop("No marker set count columns found with given suffix.")
  k <- length(score_cols)
  if (is.null(prop0)) prop0 <- 1 / k
  
  scores <- as.matrix(counts_df[, score_cols, drop = FALSE])
  n <- nrow(scores)
  pvals <- rep(NA_real_, n)
  assigned_counts <- rep(NA_real_, n)
  total_marker_counts <- rep(NA_real_, n)
  
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    ct <- celltype_vec[i]
    ct_col <- paste0(ct, suffix)
    if (!ct_col %in% colnames(scores)) {
      # assigned cluster not found among columns -> set NA
      next
    }
    assigned_counts[i] <- scores[i, ct_col]
    total_marker_counts[i] <- sum(scores[i, ], na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.na(total_marker_counts[i]) || total_marker_counts[i] < min_marker_counts) {
      pvals[i] <- NA
      next
    }
    # Binomial test: successes = assigned_counts, trials = total_marker_counts
    # H0: p = prop0 ; HA: p > prop0
    # use binom.test (exact, one-sided)
    bt <- binom.test(x = assigned_counts[i],
                     n = total_marker_counts[i],
                     p = prop0,
                     alternative = "greater")
    pvals[i] <- bt$p.value
  }
  
  # Multiple testing correction
  FDR <- rep(NA_real_, length(pvals))
  if (adjust_within == "global") {
    # adjust across all non-NA pvals
    idx <- which(!is.na(pvals))
    if (length(idx) > 0) FDR[idx] <- p.adjust(pvals[idx], method = "BH")
  } else {
    # adjust separately within each celltype
    for (ct in unique(celltype_vec)) {
      idx_ct <- which(celltype_vec == ct & !is.na(pvals))
      if (length(idx_ct) > 0) {
        FDR[idx_ct] <- p.adjust(pvals[idx_ct], method = "BH")
      }
    }
  }
  
  out <- data.frame(
    assigned_counts = assigned_counts,
    total_marker_counts = total_marker_counts,
    pval = pvals,
    FDR = FDR,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  rownames(out) <- rownames(counts_df)
  return(out)
}

# 3) Wrapper that computes counts, runs binom test, merges into seurat metadata
compute_and_store_binom_marker_significance <- function(seurat_obj,
                                                       marker_list,
                                                       celltype_meta = "cell_identity_int2",
                                                       assay = "RNA",
                                                       slot = "counts",
                                                       normalize_by_gene_count = FALSE,
                                                       min_marker_counts = 10,
                                                       adjust_within = "by_celltype",
                                                       meta_prefix = "binom_marker_") {
  counts_df <- compute_marker_set_counts(seurat_obj, marker_list,
                                         assay = assay, slot = slot,
                                         normalize_by_gene_count = normalize_by_gene_count)
  celltype_vec <- seurat_obj@meta.data[[celltype_meta]]
  if (length(celltype_vec) != nrow(counts_df)) stop("celltype vector length mismatch")
  names(celltype_vec) <- rownames(seurat_obj@meta.data)
  
  test_res <- compute_per_cell_binom_significance(counts_df, celltype_vec,
                                                  suffix = "_set_counts",
                                                  prop0 = NULL,
                                                  min_marker_counts = min_marker_counts,
                                                  adjust_within = adjust_within)
  # merge into metadata
  md <- seurat_obj@meta.data
  md[[paste0(meta_prefix, "assigned_counts")]] <- test_res$assigned_counts[rownames(md)]
  md[[paste0(meta_prefix, "total_marker_counts")]] <- test_res$total_marker_counts[rownames(md)]
  md[[paste0(meta_prefix, "pval")]] <- test_res$pval[rownames(md)]
  md[[paste0(meta_prefix, "FDR")]] <- test_res$FDR[rownames(md)]
  seurat_obj@meta.data <- md
  
  return(list(seurat = seurat_obj, counts = counts_df, test_res = test_res))
}


res_binom <- compute_and_store_binom_marker_significance(
  seurat_obj = subset(integrated_seurat,Dataset2 %in% "pDCM"),
  marker_list = intersected_genes_by_cluster_plate,
  celltype_meta = "cell_identity_int2",

  min_marker_counts = 10,           # skip tests for cells with <10 marker counts
  adjust_within = "by_celltype",    # adjust FDR within each celltype (less harsh)
  meta_prefix = "binom_marker_"
)
```

#Percentage of cells going back

```{r}

# First, get total number of cells per Dox condition
total_cells_per_dox <- int_meta_DCM2 %>%
  group_by(Dox) %>%
  summarise(total_cells = n())

# Then, compute ISC transitions and join with total cell counts
results_tuft <- int_meta_DCM3 %>%
  # Filter cells where RNA identity is ISC (initial state)
  filter(grepl("Tuft", cell_identity_int2, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(Dox) %>%
  summarise(
    Tuft_to_Tuft = sum(grepl("Tuft", cell_identity_int2_RNA, ignore.case = TRUE)),
    total_Tuft = n()
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Tuft_to_other = total_Tuft - Tuft_to_Tuft
  ) %>%
  left_join(total_cells_per_dox, by = "Dox") %>%
  mutate(
    perc_Tuft_to_Tuft = (Tuft_to_Tuft / total_cells) * 100,
    perc_Tuft_to_other = (Tuft_to_other / total_cells) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# Reshape for plotting
plot_data <- results_tuft %>%
  select(Dox, perc_Tuft_to_Tuft, perc_Tuft_to_other) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("perc"),
    names_to = "transition",
    values_to = "percentage"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    transition = case_when(
      transition == "perc_Tuft_to_Tuft" ~ "Remain Tuft",
      transition == "perc_Tuft_to_other" ~ "Become non-Tuft"
    )
  )

# Create barplot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Dox, y = percentage, fill = transition)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", percentage)),
    size=2.5,
    position = position_dodge(width = 1),
    vjust = -0.55
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Remain Tuft" = "#4CAF50", "Become non-Tuft" = "#F44336"),
    labels = c("Remain Tuft" ="Tuft DCM → Tuft RNA" , "Become non-Tuft" = "Tuft DCM → Non-Tuft RNA")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Fate of Tuft Cells",
    x = "",
    y = "Percentage of Cells (%)",
    fill = "Outcome"
  ) +
  ylim(0, 100) +
 theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "plain", color="black"),
    plot.title = element_text(size =11, face = "plain", hjust = 0.5, color="black"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "plain", hjust = 1, color="black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = "plain", angle=45,  hjust = 1, color="black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "plain", color="black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", size = 0.5),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "plain", size = 11, color="black"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"),   # overall size
    legend.key.width = unit(0.2, "cm"),  # width
    legend.key.height = unit(0.2, "cm"))+
    guides(fill= guide_legend(nrow = 2))
```

```{r}
# 4. Plotting function


plot_transition_network <- function(data, condition) {
  # Create graph object
  g <- graph_from_data_frame(
    data %>% mutate(From = as.character(From), To = as.character(To)),
    directed = TRUE
  )
  
  # Calculate hierarchical layout
  node_levels <- data %>%
    group_by(From) %>%
    summarise(out_freq = sum(Freq)) %>%
    full_join(
      data %>% group_by(To) %>% summarise(in_freq = sum(Freq)),
      by = c("From" = "To")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      level = rank(-(coalesce(in_freq, 0) + coalesce(out_freq, 0))),
      name = From
    )
  
  layout <- create_layout(
    g,
    layout = "sugiyama",
    weights = data$Freq,
    hgap = 50,
    vgap = 30
  ) %>%
    left_join(node_levels, by = "name") %>%
    mutate(
      y = level,
      x = as.numeric(factor(name))
    )
  
  # Add edge attributes
  E(g)$Freq <- data$Freq
  E(g)$Edge_Color <- data$Edge_Color
  E(g)$Edge_Type <- ifelse(data$Edge_Color == "#1B9E77", "dashed",
                          ifelse(data$Edge_Color == "#D95F02", "solid", "dashed"))
  E(g)$Edge_Alpha <- data$Edge_Alpha
  
  p <- ggraph(g, layout = "manual", x = layout$x, y = layout$y) +
    # Regular edges
    geom_edge_link(
      aes(
        width = Freq * 0.6,
        color = Edge_Color,
        linetype = Edge_Type,
        alpha = Edge_Alpha,
        strength = curve_strength,
        filter = !edge_is_loop()
      ),
      arrow = arrow(
        type = "closed", 
        length = unit(2.5, 'mm'),
        angle = 20
      ),
      end_cap = circle(5, 'mm'),
      start_cap = circle(12, 'mm'),
      lineend = "round",
      linejoin = "round"
    ) +
    # Improved self-loops with better arrow placement
    geom_edge_loop(
      aes(
        width = Freq * 0.6,
        color = Edge_Color,
        linetype = Edge_Type,
        alpha = Edge_Alpha,
         strength = 1.2,
        filter = edge_is_loop()
      ),
      arrow = arrow(
        type = "closed",
        length = unit(2.5, 'mm'),
        ends = "last"  # Ensure arrow appears at end
      ),
      strength = 1.2,  # Increased to make loop tighter
      direction = 45,   # Angle for better arrow visibility
      start_cap = circle(5, 'mm'),  # Starts farther from node
      end_cap = circle(12, 'mm'),     # Points closer to node
      lineend = "round",
      linejoin = "round",
      n = 100          # Smoother curve
    ) +
    # Rest of the styling...
    scale_edge_linetype_manual(
      name = "Transition Type",
      values = c("dashed", "solid"),
      labels = c("To Enterocyte", "From Enterocyte")
    ) +
    scale_edge_color_identity(
      name = "Transition Type",
      breaks = c("#1B9E77", "#D95F02", "gray"),
      labels = c("To Enterocyte", "From Enterocyte", "Other transitions"),
      guide = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(
          edge_width = 1.5,
          linetype = c("dashed", "solid", "dashed"),
          alpha = 1
        ),
        order = 1
      )
    ) +
    scale_edge_width(
      range = c(0.3, 3),
      name = "Frequency",
      guide = guide_legend(order = 2)
    ) +
    geom_node_point(
      size = 12,
      color = "white",
      fill = "darkred",
      shape = 21,
      stroke = 1
    ) +
    geom_node_text(
      aes(label = name), 
      color = "black",
      size = 4.5,
      fontface = "bold",
      family = "sans",
      repel = TRUE,
      box.padding = 0.5
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    labs(
      title = condition,
      subtitle = "Hierarchical transition network"
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 2), "cm")
    ) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1.2)
  
  return(p)
}

plot_transition_network <- function(data, condition) {
  # Create graph object
  g <- graph_from_data_frame(
    data %>% mutate(From = as.character(From), To = as.character(To)),
    directed = TRUE
  )
  
  # Calculate hierarchical layout
  node_levels <- data %>%
    group_by(From) %>%
    summarise(out_freq = sum(Freq)) %>%
    full_join(
      data %>% group_by(To) %>% summarise(in_freq = sum(Freq)),
      by = c("From" = "To")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      level = rank(-(coalesce(in_freq, 0) + coalesce(out_freq, 0))),
      name = From
    )
  
  layout <- create_layout(
    g,
    layout = "sugiyama",
    weights = data$Freq,
    hgap = 50,
    vgap = 30
  ) %>%
    left_join(node_levels, by = "name") %>%
    mutate(
      y = level,
      x = as.numeric(factor(name))
    )
  
  # Add edge attributes with custom dash patterns
  E(g)$Freq <- data$Freq
  E(g)$Edge_Color <- data$Edge_Color
  E(g)$Edge_Type <- ifelse(data$Edge_Color == "#1B9E77", "solid",
                          ifelse(data$Edge_Color == "#D95F02", "solid", "solid"))
  E(g)$Edge_Alpha <- data$Edge_Alpha
  
  p <- ggraph(g, layout = "manual", x = layout$x, y = layout$y) +
    # Regular edges with custom dash patterns
    geom_edge_link(
      aes(
        width = Freq * 0.6,
        color = Edge_Color,
        linetype = Edge_Type,  # Now using custom patterns
        alpha = Edge_Alpha,
        filter = !edge_is_loop()
      ),
      arrow = arrow(
        type = "closed", 
        length = unit(2.5, 'mm'),
        angle = 20
      ),
      end_cap = circle(8, 'mm'),
      start_cap = circle(8, 'mm'),
      lineend = "round",
      linejoin = "round"
    ) +
    # Self-loops with custom dash patterns
    geom_edge_loop(
      aes(
        width = Freq * 0.6,
        color = Edge_Color,
        linetype = Edge_Type,  # Consistent with regular edges
        alpha = Edge_Alpha,
        filter = edge_is_loop()
      ),
      arrow = arrow(
        type = "closed",
        length = unit(2.5, 'mm'),
        ends = "last"
      ),
      strength = 1.2,
      direction = 45,
      start_cap = circle(12, 'mm'),
      end_cap = circle(5, 'mm'),
      lineend = "round",
      linejoin = "round",
      n = 100
    ) +
    # Custom line types with more pronounced dashes
    scale_edge_linetype_manual(
      name = "Transition Type",
      values = c("solid", "solid", "solid","solid"),  # More pronounced dashes
      labels = c("From Secretory To Absorptive", "From Secretory To Secretory", "From Secretory To Stem", "From Absorptive To Stem","Other transitions"),
      guide = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(
          edge_width = 1.5,
          alpha = 1
        )
      )
    ) +
    scale_edge_color_identity(
      name = "Transition Type",
      breaks = c("#1B9E77", "#2C7BB6", "#FBAF00","#D62728","gray"),
      labels = c("From Secretory To Absorptive", "From Secretory To Secretory", "From Secretory To Stem", "From Absorptive To Stem","Other transitions"),
      guide = "none"  # Color info now shown in linetype legend
    ) +
    scale_edge_width(
      range = c(0.3, 3),
      name = "Frequency",
      guide = guide_legend(order = 2)
    ) +
    geom_node_point(
      size = 12,
      color = "white",
      fill = "darkred",
      shape = 21,
      stroke = 1
    ) +
    geom_node_text(
      aes(label = name), 
      color = "black",
      size = 4.5,
      fontface = "bold",
      family = "sans",
      repel = TRUE,
      box.padding = 0.5
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    labs(
      title = condition,
      subtitle = "Hierarchical transition network"
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 2), "cm"),
      legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm")  # Wider legend keys for better dash visibility
    ) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1.2)
  
  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
transitions_filtered <- transitions_filtered %>%

  ) %>%
  group_by(pair_id) %>%
  mutate(
    is_bidirectional = n() > 1,
    curve_strength = ifelse(is_bidirectional, ifelse(From < To, 0.3, -0.3), 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

plot_transition_network <- function(data, condition) {
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggraph)
  library(igraph)
  library(tidygraph)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(grid)

  # Preprocess: mark bidirectional edges and assign curvature
  data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    From = as.character(From),
    To = as.character(To),
    pair_id = ifelse(From < To, paste(From, To, sep = "|"), paste(To, From, sep = "|"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(pair_id) %>%
  mutate(
    is_bidirectional = n() > 1,
    curve_strength = ifelse(is_bidirectional, ifelse(From < To, 0.3, -0.3), 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

  # Create graph object
  g <- graph_from_data_frame(
    data %>% mutate(From = as.character(From), To = as.character(To)),
    directed = TRUE
  )

  # Add edge attributes
  E(g)$Freq <- data$Freq
  E(g)$Edge_Color <- data$Edge_Color
  E(g)$Edge_Type <- ifelse(
    data$Edge_Color == "#1B9E77", "solid",
    ifelse(data$Edge_Color == "#D95F02", "solid", "solid")
  )
  E(g)$Edge_Alpha <- data$Edge_Alpha
  E(g)$curve_strength <- data$curve_strength

  # Calculate hierarchical layout
  node_levels <- data %>%
    group_by(From) %>%
    summarise(out_freq = sum(Freq)) %>%
    full_join(
      data %>% group_by(To) %>% summarise(in_freq = sum(Freq)),
      by = c("From" = "To")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      level = rank(-(coalesce(in_freq, 0) + coalesce(out_freq, 0))),
      name = From
    )

  layout <- create_layout(
    g,
    layout = "sugiyama",
    weights = data$Freq,
    hgap = 50,
    vgap = 30
  ) %>%
    left_join(node_levels, by = "name") %>%
    mutate(
      y = level,
      x = as.numeric(factor(name))
    )

  # Plot
  p <- ggraph(g, layout = "manual", x = layout$x, y = layout$y) +
    # Regular edges (with curvature)
    geom_edge_link(
      aes(
        width = Freq * 0.6,
        color = Edge_Color,
        linetype = Edge_Type,
        alpha = Edge_Alpha,
        strength = curve_strength,  # <- include it here!
        filter = !edge_is_loop()
      ),
      arrow = arrow(
        type = "closed",
        length = unit(2.5, 'mm'),
        angle = 20
      ),
      end_cap = circle(8, 'mm'),
      start_cap = circle(8, 'mm'),
      lineend = "round",
      linejoin = "round"
    )+
    # Self-loops
   geom_edge_loop(
      aes(
        width = Freq * 0.6,
        color = Edge_Color,
        linetype = Edge_Type,
        alpha = Edge_Alpha,
        strength = 1.2,            # <- keep here
        filter = edge_is_loop()
      ),
      arrow = arrow(
        type = "closed",
        length = unit(2.5, 'mm'),
        ends = "last"
      ),
      start_cap = circle(12, 'mm'),
      end_cap = circle(5, 'mm'),
      lineend = "round",
      linejoin = "round",
      n = 100
    ) +
    # Edge aesthetics
    scale_edge_linetype_manual(
      name = "Transition Type",
      values = c("solid", "solid", "solid", "solid"),
      labels = c(
        "From Secretory To Absorptive",
        "From Secretory To Secretory",
        "From Secretory To Stem",
        "From Absorptive To Stem",
        "Other transitions"
      ),
      guide = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(edge_width = 1.5, alpha = 1)
      )
    ) +
    scale_edge_color_identity(
      name = "Transition Type",
      breaks = c("#1B9E77", "#D95F02", "#7570B3", "#E7298A", "gray"),
      labels = c(
        "From Secretory To Absorptive",
        "From Secretory To Secretory",
        "From Secretory To Stem",
        "From Absorptive To Stem",
        "Other transitions"
      ),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    scale_edge_width(
      range = c(0.3, 3),
      name = "Frequency",
      guide = guide_legend(order = 2)
    ) +
    # Node aesthetics
    geom_node_point(
      size = 12,
      color = "white",
      fill = "darkred",
      shape = 21,
      stroke = 1
    ) +
    geom_node_text(
      aes(label = name),
      color = "black",
      size = 4.5,
      fontface = "bold",
      family = "sans",
      repel = TRUE,
      box.padding = 0.5
    ) +
    # Theme
    theme_void() +
    labs(
      title = condition,
      subtitle = "Hierarchical transition network"
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 2), "cm"),
      legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm")
    ) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1.2)

  return(p)
}
```

#UMAP connecting cells DCM RNA with arrow per transition


```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
int_meta_DCM2_4

integrated_seurat
# 1. Extract UMAP coordinates
umap_df <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(integrated_seurat, "umap"))
umap_df$cell_id <- rownames(umap_df)

# 2. Extract metadata and merge
meta <- integrated_seurat@meta.data
meta$cell_id <- rownames(meta)

merged_df <- merge(umap_df, meta, by = "cell_id")
merged_df$biotype <- merged_df$Dataset2
merged_df$biotype <- recode(merged_df$biotype,
                            "Large_dataset" = "Ref",
                            "Atlas_dataset" = "Ref",
                            "pRNA" = "RNA",
                            "pDCM" = "DCM")


# 3. Identify paired cells (same original identity but different sources)
paired_cells <- merged_df %>%
  group_by(Sample_RNA) %>%
  filter(n() == 2, all(c("RNA", "DCM") %in% biotype)) %>%
  arrange(Sample_RNA, biotype)

# 4. Prepare arrows
arrow_df <- paired_cells %>%
  summarise(
    x = umap_1[biotype == "RNA"],
    y = umap_2[biotype == "RNA"],
    xend = umap_1[biotype == "DCM"],
    yend = umap_2[biotype == "DCM"]
  )

# 5. Custom colors
# Use default cluster colors
n_clusters <- length(unique(merged_df$cell_identity_int2))
gray_shades <- gray.colors(n_clusters, start = 0.8, end = 0.2)  # light to dark grays
names(gray_shades) <- sort(unique(merged_df$cell_identity_int2))
names(cluster_colors) <- levels(as.factor(merged_df$cell_identity_int2))

# 6. Mark RNA/DCM paired for styling
merged_df$pair_status <- "normal"
merged_df$pair_status[merged_df$cell_id %in% paired_cells$cell_id[paired_cells$biotype == "RNA"]] <- "RNA_pair"
merged_df$pair_status[merged_df$cell_id %in% paired_cells$cell_id[paired_cells$biotype == "DCM"]] <- "DCM_pair"

# 7. Plot
ggplot() +
  # Normal points
  geom_point(data = merged_df %>% filter(pair_status == "normal"),
             aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2, color = as.factor(cell_identity_int2)),
             size = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +

  # RNA paired points
  geom_point(data = merged_df %>% filter(pair_status == "RNA_pair"),
             aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2),
             color = "darkred", fill = "darkred",
             shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.5) +
  
  # DCM paired points
  geom_point(data = merged_df %>% filter(pair_status == "DCM_pair"),
             aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2),
             color = "darkgreen", fill = "darkgreen",
             shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.5) +
  
  # Arrows between RNA and DCM
  geom_segment(data = arrow_df,
               aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
               color = "black", size = 0.3) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = gray_shades) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  labs(title = "UMAP with RNA/DCM cell pairs connected",
       color = "Cluster")

```

#Network prediction in umap from ISC to predicted cell type

```{r}
annotation_df_sc_filt <- annotation_df_sc[annotation_df_sc$MS_DCM == "Concordant",]
Palantir_scbackfilt <- Palantir_scback[,colnames(Palantir_scback) %in% rownames(annotation_df_sc_filt) ]
RNA_velocity_scbackfilt <- RNA_velocity_scback[,colnames(RNA_velocity_scback) %in% rownames(annotation_df_sc_filt) ]
Cytotrace_scbackfilt <- Cytotrace_scback[,colnames(Cytotrace_scback) %in% rownames(annotation_df_sc_filt) ]


umap_coords_integrated <- integrated_seurat@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings
umap_coords_integrated <- data.frame(umap_coords_integrated)
# Example: a data frame of UMAP coordinates per cell
umap_cells <- data.frame(
  cell_id = rownames(umap_coords_integrated),          # same order as columns in pred_mat
  UMAP_1 = umap_coords_integrated$umap_1,                          # fill with your real UMAP_1 values
  UMAP_2 = umap_coords_integrated$umap_2,                          # fill with your real UMAP_2 values
  cell_type = integrated_seurat$cell_identity_int2                        # categorical label per cell (e.g., predicted or annotated cluster)
)


centroids <- umap_cells %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarise(
    x = mean(UMAP_1),
    y = mean(UMAP_2)
  ) %>%
  mutate(cell_type = paste0(cell_type, "_pre"))  # Add "_pre" suffix

isc_center <- data.frame(
  cell_type = "ISC",
  x = mean(umap_cells$UMAP_1),  # or set a known fixed point
  y = mean(umap_cells$UMAP_2)
)

nodes <- bind_rows(isc_center, centroids)

weights <- rowMeans(Palantir_scbackfilt)
weights_cy <- rowMeans(Cytotrace_scbackfilt)
weights_Vel <- rowMeans(RNA_velocity_scbackfilt)

edges <- data.frame(
  from = "ISC",
  to = paste0(names(weights),"_pre"),
  weight = weights
)

edges_cy <- data.frame(
  from = "ISC",
  to = paste0(names(weights_cy),"_pre"),
  weight = weights_cy
)
edges_vel <- data.frame(
  from = "ISC",
  to = paste0(names(weights_Vel),"_pre"),
  weight = weights_Vel
)

# Add coordinates
edges <- edges %>%
  left_join(nodes, by = c("from" = "cell_type")) %>%
  rename(x_start = x, y_start = y) %>%
  left_join(nodes, by = c("to" = "cell_type")) %>%
  rename(x_end = x, y_end = y)
# Add coordinates
edges_cy <- edges_cy %>%
  left_join(nodes, by = c("from" = "cell_type")) %>%
  rename(x_start = x, y_start = y) %>%
  left_join(nodes, by = c("to" = "cell_type")) %>%
  rename(x_end = x, y_end = y)
# Add coordinates
edges_vel <- edges_vel %>%
  left_join(nodes, by = c("from" = "cell_type")) %>%
  rename(x_start = x, y_start = y) %>%
  left_join(nodes, by = c("to" = "cell_type")) %>%
  rename(x_end = x, y_end = y)

cell_types <- c("ISC", "Paneth", "Enterocyte", "Goblet", "Tuft", "Enteroendocrine")
cell_type_colors <- c("#88CCEE", "#44AA99", "#117733", "#999933", "#DDCC77", "#CC6677")
names(cell_type_colors) <- cell_types
edges$pred_type <- gsub("_pre$", "", edges$to)
edges_cy$pred_type <- gsub("_pre$", "", edges_cy$to)
edges_vel$pred_type <- gsub("_pre$", "", edges_vel$to)



library(scales)
edges$weight_scaled <- rescale(edges$weight, to = c(0.5, 3))  # adjust range as needed
edges_cy$weight_scaled <- rescale(edges_cy$weight, to = c(0.5, 3))  # adjust range as needed
edges_vel$weight_scaled <- rescale(edges_vel$weight, to = c(0.5, 3))  # adjust range as needed


p <- ggplot() +
  # Optional: background UMAP points
  geom_point(data = umap_cells, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2), color = "gray90", size = 0.3) +

  # Arrows from ISC to predicted cell types
  geom_segment(data = edges_vel,
               aes(x = x_start, y = y_start, xend = x_end, yend = y_end,
                   size = weight, color = pred_type),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm"))) +

  # Node points
  geom_point(data = nodes, aes(x = x, y = y), color = "steelblue", size = 4) +
  geom_text(data = nodes, aes(x = x, y = y, label = cell_type), vjust = -1, size = 1.8) +

  # Manual color scale
  scale_color_manual(values = cell_type_colors) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5, 3)) +

   theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    plot.title =  element_blank(),
    axis.text =  element_blank(),
    axis.ticks =  element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line =  element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"),   # overall size
    legend.key.width = unit(0.2, "cm"),  # width
    legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "cm")) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(title = "Predicted Cell Type Flow from ISC",
       color = "Predicted Type")

 # Save the plot
  g <- ggplotGrob(p)

# Extract all legend boxes
  legends <- g$grobs[which(sapply(g$grobs, function(x) x$name) == "guide-box")]

# Save each legend manually (they're stacked in one box)
  legend_combined <- legends[[1]]  # Usually contains both

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,"Umap_palantir_prediction_per_cluster_legend.png"),legend_combined,  dpi=300, width =2.15, height = 1.5)
  p_nolegend <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,"Umap_palantir_prediction_per_cluster.png"), p_nolegend,dpi=300,width = 3, height = 3)

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,"Umap_cytotrace_prediction_per_cluster_legend.png"),legend_combined,  dpi=300, width =2.15, height = 1.5)
  p_nolegend <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,"Umap_cytotrace_prediction_per_cluster.png"), p_nolegend,dpi=300,width = 3, height = 3)


ggsave(file.path(output_dir,"Umap_velocity_prediction_per_cluster_legend.png"),legend_combined,  dpi=300, width =2.15, height = 1.5)
  p_nolegend <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave(file.path(output_dir,"Umap_velocity_prediction_per_cluster.png"), p_nolegend,dpi=300,width = 3, height = 3)
```

```{r}
annotation_df_sc_filt$CellType_RNA <- factor(annotation_df_sc_filt$CellType_RNA, levels = unique(annotation_df_sc_filt$CellType_RNA))

annotation_df_sc_filt$CellType_DCM <- factor(annotation_df_sc_filt$CellType_DCM, levels = unique(annotation_df_sc_filt$CellType_DCM))

dcm_isc_freq <- as.data.frame(table(DCM = annotation_df_sc_filt$CellType_DCM, ISC_RNA = annotation_df_sc_filt$CellType_RNA))
colnames(dcm_isc_freq) <- c("from", "to", "weight")

unique_dcm <- unique(dcm_isc_freq$from)
dcm_nodes <- data.frame(
  cell_type = paste0(unique_dcm,"_DCM"),
  x = seq(min(umap_cells$UMAP_1), max(umap_cells$UMAP_1), length.out = length(unique_dcm)),
  y = max(umap_cells$UMAP_2) + 3  # position above the UMAP
)

dcm_edges <- dcm_isc_freq %>%
  left_join(dcm_nodes, by = c("from" = "cell_type")) %>%
  rename(x_start = x, y_start = y) %>%
  left_join(nodes, by = c("to" = "cell_type")) %>%
  rename(x_end = x, y_end = y)

ggplot() +
  # Background UMAP
  geom_point(data = umap_cells, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2), color = "gray90", size = 0.3) +

  # Arrows from DCM → ISC
  geom_segment(data = dcm_edges,
               aes(x = x_start, y = y_start, xend = x_end, yend = y_end, size = weight),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), color = "gray40", alpha = 0.6) +

  # Arrows from ISC → Predicted
  geom_segment(data = edges,
               aes(x = x_start, y = y_start, xend = x_end, yend = y_end,
                   size = weight, color = pred_type),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm"))) +

  # All nodes (DCM + ISC + Predicted)
  geom_point(data = bind_rows(nodes, dcm_nodes), aes(x = x, y = y), color = "steelblue", size = 4) +
  geom_text(data = bind_rows(nodes, dcm_nodes), aes(x = x, y = y, label = cell_type), vjust = -1) +

  scale_color_manual(values = cell_type_colors) +
  guides(size = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(title = "DCM → RNA → Prediction Flow", color = "Predicted Cell Type")

dcm_edges <- dcm_isc_freq %>%
  mutate(from_dcm = paste0(from, "_DCM")) %>%  # <-- key fix
  left_join(dcm_nodes, by = c("from_dcm" = "cell_type")) %>%
  rename(x_start = x, y_start = y) %>%
  left_join(nodes, by = c("to" = "cell_type")) %>%
  rename(x_end = x, y_end = y)

dcm_nodes <- data.frame(cell_type = unique(dcm_edges$from_dcm))

dcm_nodes$pred_type <- gsub("_DCM$", "", dcm_nodes$cell_type)

umap_centroids <- umap_cells %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarise(
    x = median(UMAP_1),
    y = median(UMAP_2)
  )

dcm_nodes <- dcm_nodes %>%
  left_join(umap_centroids, by = c("pred_type" = "cell_type")) %>%
  mutate(
    x = x ,  # jitter to separate overlapping nodes
    y = y
  )

dcm_nodes$y[1] <- 2.19
dcm_nodes$y[2] <- -12.5

dcm_edges$y_start[1] <- 2.19
```

Add a new chunk by clicking the *Insert Chunk* button on the toolbar or by pressing *Ctrl+Alt+I*.

When you save the notebook, an HTML file containing the code and output will be saved alongside it (click the *Preview* button or press *Ctrl+Shift+K* to preview the HTML file).

The preview shows you a rendered HTML copy of the contents of the editor. Consequently, unlike *Knit*, *Preview* does not run any R code chunks. Instead, the output of the chunk when it was last run in the editor is displayed.
